================================================================================
PETIKA — CHANGELOG
================================================================================

Version 1.0.0 (2026-11-23) — Initial Commercial Release
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- INITIAL RELEASE: Commercial distribution package for ThemeForest, UI8, and Creative Market.
- CORE ARCHITECTURE:
  * Bootstrap 5.3.3 local minified integration.
  * 100% Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+) — zero jQuery runtime dependencies.
  * 3-tier CSS custom property token system for 60-second color rebranding.
- THEME ENGINE:
  * Dual theme system: Dark Mode (Obsidian & Radiant Amber) and Light Mode (Alabaster Gallery & Amber Bronze).
  * Pre-render inline script in <head> guaranteeing zero Flash-Of-Unstyled-Theme (FOUT).
  * User theme preference persistence via localStorage with prefers-color-scheme fallback.
- SECTIONS & COMPONENTS:
  * Sticky glassmorphism header with active scroll-spy and pulsating availability beacon.
  * Bento Hero Grid with 3 live animated metric counters and portrait card.
  * About & Philosophy bento module with 3 core tenets and local timezone status bar.
  * Filterable Portfolio Showcase with 6 bento case study cards.
  * Interactive Project Case Study Modal displaying problem overview, challenge vs solution, metrics bar, and tech chips.
  * Career Journey interactive timeline with company credentials and achievements.
  * Skills & Competencies 3-pillar bento grid (Design, Frontend, Tools).
  * Client Testimonials cards with 5-star ratings and verified client badges.
  * Interactive Contact Hub with 1-click clipboard copy pills and client-side validated form with honeypot anti-spam.
  * Minimalist footer with back-to-top floating button.
  * Custom 404 error page.
- QUALITY & COMPLIANCE:
  * 100% W3C HTML5 Validated markup.
  * WCAG 2.1 AA Contrast and Keyboard Accessibility verified.
  * Audited across 6 viewports (375px to 1920px) with 0px horizontal overflow.
  * Standalone in-browser HTML documentation manual included.
